module: Flowgraph node 'Switch Case' (logic category). Compares the input value 'value' with N values value_i (strict equality) and sets the matching output match_i to true; 'none' is true if none match. The output flow is always true.
notes: The flow output is always true, even if the input flow is inactive: the input pin 'flow' is not read.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the middle of the node (empty).

updatePins.desc: Creates or deletes the value_i and match_i pins and the associated links.

work.desc: flow=true; for each i, match_i = (value_i == value); none = no match.

_onDeserialized.desc: Reads back count (1 by default) and recreates the pins.
